cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you for helping me move. You may choose books or plates; I like my helpers to feel at home.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're wonderfully careful. I've approved you for plates; I'll handle the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely initiative. I approve you for boxing too. I'll take the books downstairs and leave you in charge of the whole kitchen. What a comfort you are.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 grants a choice, A3 warmly awards the unwanted plates and A5 approves more responsibility instead of requested help, using superior permission to shrink B options appreciatively.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 breakage concern becomes A3 carefulness qualification; B4 wrap-only compromise becomes A5 boxing duty and A departure.

relationship.evidence: B2 is a volunteer worried about china and B4 seeks shared handling, making the narrowing materially affect a plausible preference.

heightening.evidence: B4 proposed division causes A5 to frame solo packing as being put in charge of the kitchen.

specificity.evidence: A1 move, B2 books/fragile china and B4 boxes establish concrete tasks; A5 downstairs trip fits the move.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 what a comfort you are rewards B with the job they wanted help avoiding, earned by B4 actual proposal.

coach2.inferred: A appreciation can be sincere while the freedom it advertises is illusory.
coach2.missing: No essential fact missing; no hidden packing task is introduced at the end.
coach2.firstDefect: Cold prefixed reprimand is removed and every A turn sustains warm control.

A1-B2.evidence: B2 chooses books from A1 options and gives a concern about plates.

A3-B4.evidence: B4 requests a smaller plate task with A boxing.

B4-A5.evidence: A5 approves B4 initiative but expands B to boxing too and takes A away.
